subtasks: Use the set square to push the three blocks into a straight, aligned row, then reset the robot arm.
Push the long white set square forward along the tabletop against all three magenta cubes until their faces line up. Do not grasp any cube.
Leave the straight row of three cubes and the white square undisturbed. With both grippers fully open, withdraw the left hand from the square and return both arms to their initial poses.
